description: Stefania Degli Abbati and colleagues at the University of Genoa publish numerical building models and accelerograms for assessing masonry retrofits. The April 2025 ZIP is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Although its Zenodo description is empty, the publisher’s data-availability statement explicitly identifies the deposit and its contents. The study covers two Italian unreinforced masonry buildings in original and strengthened configurations, with stiff and soft soil cases. Equivalent-frame models and multiple-stripe dynamic analyses produce fragility estimates for usability-preventing damage and global collapse. These materials can compare retrofit assumptions in building-risk simulations. Solver dependencies and archive file formats remain unknown from the inspected metadata. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the package. The archive was not downloaded, and neither model validity nor reported retrofit effectiveness was independently tested.
